title: Lumbar motion segment 6x6 stiffness matrix, intact, 0 N axial preload (L2-3/L4-5)

quantity.name: 6x6 stiffness matrix (linearised)
quantity.definition: Least-squares linearised stiffness from 2nd-3rd of 4 sawtooth cycles of +-0.5 mm A-P/lateral, +-0.35 mm axial, +-1.5 deg lateral bending, +-1 deg flexion-extension and torsion. Gardner-Morse & Stokes 2004 Figs 1-2: 6x6 stiffness of the UPPER vertebral body centre relative to the FIXED lower vertebra; nodes at vertebral body centres (located radiographically). FE-style axes: axis 1 = axial, pointing inferior (positive F1/D1 = compression of the segment); axis 2 = antero-posterior, pointing posterior; axis 3 = lateral (right-handed with 1 and 2, i.e. pointing to the specimen's left). DOF 1-3 translations (mm), DOF 4-6 rotations about axes 1,2,3 = axial rotation, lateral bending, flexion-extension (rad in the paper). Off-diagonal terms were averaged to make the matrix symmetric (k_ij = k_ji, only upper triangle tabulated). Terms expected zero by sagittal symmetry not reported; k12 (axial-A-P coupling) not significantly different from zero and not tabulated. Signs as printed (k16, k35, k45 negative). Positive rotation sense: right-hand rule about the axes (FE convention; not stated explicitly in text).

source.n: 8 motion segments (L2-3 x4, L4-5 x4) from 4 female spines
source.sample: human cadaveric lumbar motion segments, no gross degeneration (some osteophytes in older specimens)

protocol.summary: Hexapod (Stewart platform) displacement control, 6 pure DOF tests, 4 sawtooth cycles of 87 s, 1 Hz sampling, specimens in ~4 C isotonic saline bath, 0 N axial compressive preload (equilibrated >=3 h), preload order varied.
how_to_simulate: Model L2-L3 and/or L4-L5 motion segment; fix the lower vertebra and define the node at the upper vertebral body centre (mean centre-to-centre distance 36.3 mm)
Apply 0 N axial compressive preload along axis 1 and let the model equilibrate (no follower path needed: single segment)

From the preloaded state impose each pure displacement separately with the other 5 DOF held fixed: +-0.5 mm A-P and lateral, +-0.35 mm axial, +-1.5 deg lateral bending, +-1 deg flexion-extension and axial rotation

Record the 6 reaction forces/moments at the upper vertebral centre, fit the linear slope per DOF, symmetrise the off-diagonals, convert to N/mm, N/deg and Nm/deg and compare term by term (diagonal within mean +-1 SD; off-diagonal sign and order of magnitude)
protocol.notes: Coordinate system: Gardner-Morse & Stokes 2004 Figs 1-2: 6x6 stiffness of the UPPER vertebral body centre relative to the FIXED lower vertebra; nodes at vertebral body centres (located radiographically). FE-style axes: axis 1 = axial, pointing inferior (positive F1/D1 = compression of the segment); axis 2 = antero-posterior, pointing posterior; axis 3 = lateral (right-handed with 1 and 2, i.e. pointing to the specimen's left). DOF 1-3 translations (mm), DOF 4-6 rotations about axes 1,2,3 = axial rotation, lateral bending, flexion-extension (rad in the paper). Off-diagonal terms were averaged to make the matrix symmetric (k_ij = k_ji, only upper triangle tabulated). Terms expected zero by sagittal symmetry not reported; k12 (axial-A-P coupling) not significantly different from zero and not tabulated. Signs as printed (k16, k35, k45 negative). Positive rotation sense: right-hand rule about the axes (FE convention; not stated explicitly in text). SE reported in the paper; 'sd' = SE*sqrt(n) (derived: n=8 pooled, n=4 per level). Specimen means (radiographs): 36.3 mm (33.0-39.8) between vertebral centres, disc lateral width 45.5 mm (41.2-58.1), A-P width 32.5 mm (30.0-34.7), disc height 8.9 mm (6.4-10.3). Same specimens tested again with posterior elements removed (see isolated-disc test). At 0 N preload no level differences; all values are means of L2-3 and L4-5.

extraction.uncertainty: tabulated values (3 significant figures); converted from N, mm, rad
extraction.check_notes: All values re-read from rendered Table 1 image (pdftotext dropped minus signs: k16, k35, k45 are negative in the printed table). Conversion: N/rad -> N/deg x(pi/180); N·mm/rad -> Nm/deg /(1000*180/pi). Native values kept in data[].native. SD derived from SE x sqrt(n).

pass_rule.rule: each diagonal term within mean +- 1 SD; off-diagonal terms: same sign and order of magnitude
